notes: Lighting glossary and one-click setups. All descriptions are original wording compiled from public cinematography sources; no text copied from the American Cinematographer Manual. azimuth_deg: 0 = from camera, +90 = camera-left, -90 = camera-right, 180 = behind subject. elevation_deg relative to subject eye line.

terms.meaning: The main, brightest source on the subject; it sets the exposure, direction and mood of the shot.
A weaker source on the opposite side from the key that lifts the shadows the key creates, controlling how dark they get.
A source behind the subject aimed toward camera that outlines the head and shoulders, separating them from the background.
terms.prompt_words: rim light outlining the subject, backlit

terms.meaning: A back-side light from roughly three-quarters behind the subject that skims one cheek or jaw edge, usually on the shadow side.
A light placed above and behind the subject that adds sheen and shape to the hair and top of the head.
terms.prompt_words: glowing hair light from above and behind

terms.meaning: A narrow, grazing light that draws a thin bright line along the silhouette of a face or object.
A small reflection of a light source in the eyes that makes them look alive; often added with a small lamp near the lens.
Lighting designed so it appears to come from a believable source in the scene, like a window, lamp or screen.
terms.prompt_words: naturalistic motivated lighting from the window

terms.meaning: A light fixture visible in the frame (table lamp, sconce, neon sign) that also contributes to the scene's illumination.
The general, non-directional light already present in a space, from sky, walls and surroundings.
Light reflected off a white card, foamcore or wall to create a larger, softer, less directional source.
Black material placed near the subject to absorb stray light and deepen shadows on one side, increasing contrast.
terms.prompt_words: deep shadow side, negative fill, sculpted contrast

terms.meaning: An opaque black panel on a stand used to block light from hitting part of the set, lens or subject.
terms.prompt_words: controlled light, shadows cut by flags

terms.meaning: A long, narrow flag used to slice a straight-edged band of light off a wall or background.
terms.prompt_words: hard-edged shadow cut across the wall

terms.meaning: Translucent fabric or gel placed in front of a lamp to spread and soften the light and reduce harsh shadows.
A source bounced into a reflector and then passed through a diffusion frame, producing a very large, wrapping, controllable soft key.
A large source relative to the subject gives gradual shadow edges (soft); a small or distant source gives crisp, defined shadows (hard).
terms.prompt_words: soft diffused light / hard crisp shadows

terms.meaning: Compares the lit side with the shadow side. 2:1 is one stop of difference and reads gentle and bright; 4:1 is two stops and reads dramatic but natural; 8:1 is three stops and reads moody, with deep shadows.
Bright, even lighting with low contrast and few shadows, typical of comedy, commercials and upbeat scenes.
Dark, high-contrast lighting dominated by shadow, with only selected areas lit; common in noir, thriller and horror.
terms.prompt_words: low-key lighting, deep shadows, high contrast

terms.meaning: A painterly approach built on strong contrast between bright light and deep darkness to model form and create drama.
Key placed about 45 degrees to the side and above eye level so a small triangle of light appears on the shadow-side cheek.
terms.prompt_words: Rembrandt lighting, triangle of light on cheek

terms.meaning: Key placed high and directly in line with the lens, casting a small symmetrical shadow under the nose; a classic glamour look.
Key placed slightly off-axis (around 30 to 40 degrees) and above, so the nose shadow forms a small loop toward the cheek.
Key placed 90 degrees to the side so exactly half of the face is lit and the other half falls into shadow.
terms.prompt_words: split lighting, half face in shadow

terms.meaning: Broad lighting lights the side of the face turned toward camera (widens the face); short lighting lights the side turned away (slims and adds mood).
terms.prompt_words: short lighting, far side of face lit

terms.meaning: A beauty setup with a key above the lens and a fill or reflector below it, wrapping the face in soft, nearly shadowless light.
Light coming straight down from overhead, shading the eye sockets and creating a hard, oppressive or mysterious mood.
terms.prompt_words: harsh overhead top light, shadowed eyes

terms.meaning: Light from below the face, which reverses natural shadows and makes features look unsettling.
Two sources from opposite sides, each acting as key for one side or as rim for the other; common for two-person scenes.
The subject is unlit against a bright background so it reads as a dark shape with no interior detail.
Shooting in daylight and underexposing, often with a cool tint, to simulate night.
The period just after sunrise or before sunset when the sun is low, warm and soft, with long shadows.
terms.prompt_words: golden hour, warm low sun, long shadows

terms.meaning: Twilight just before sunrise or after sunset when the sun is below the horizon and the sky casts deep blue, shadowless light.
terms.prompt_words: blue hour twilight, deep blue sky light

terms.meaning: Cloud cover turns the sky into a huge diffuser, giving even, soft, low-contrast daylight.
High midday sun produces small, dark shadows directly beneath features and high contrast.
Describes the warmth or coolness of white light in Kelvin; tungsten film lights are about 3200K (warm), daylight about 5600K (cool).
Color-correction filters: CTO (orange) warms a daylight source toward tungsten; CTB (blue) cools a tungsten source toward daylight.
terms.prompt_words: warm CTO-gelled light / cool blue CTB light

terms.meaning: Deliberately combining warm and cool sources in one frame, such as warm lamps inside against blue dusk outside.
terms.prompt_words: mixed warm and cool lighting, teal and orange

terms.meaning: Orange-yellow streetlight with a narrow spectrum, a signature of urban night exteriors.
Film convention renders moonlight as a cool blue backlight or side light, even though real moonlight is close to sunlight in color.
Warm, low-angle, constantly shifting light from flames, mimicked on set with flicker effects on orange sources.
Light intensity drops with the square of distance, so a close source falls off quickly across the scene while a distant one stays even.
Streaks, veils or ghosts caused when a bright source shines into the lens, often from a backlight or sun.
Haze or smoke in the air makes light beams visible and adds depth and softness.
Modern LED fixtures, including flat panels and handheld tubes, with adjustable color temperature and full color output.
Shooting with whatever light already exists at the location, without adding film lights.

setups.label: Classic three-point
setups.summary: Key at 45 degrees, fill on the opposite side at lower level, and a backlight for separation; the foundation of most interview and drama lighting.

sun.notes: Interior or controlled stage; sun disabled.

setups.prompt_words: classic three-point lighting, key fill and rim light

setups.label: Rembrandt
setups.summary: Single high key around 45 to 50 degrees to the side with little fill, leaving a lit triangle on the shadow cheek.

sun.notes: Interior or controlled stage; sun disabled.

setups.prompt_words: Rembrandt lighting, triangle of light on the cheek, painterly shadows

setups.label: Butterfly / Paramount
setups.summary: Key directly above the lens pointing down at the face, producing a symmetrical shadow under the nose; old-Hollywood glamour.

sun.notes: Interior or controlled stage; sun disabled.

setups.prompt_words: Paramount butterfly lighting, glamorous old Hollywood portrait

setups.label: Loop
setups.summary: Key about 35 degrees off-axis and slightly high, so the nose shadow forms a small loop toward the cheek; flattering and natural.

sun.notes: Interior or controlled stage; sun disabled.

setups.prompt_words: loop lighting, flattering soft portrait light

setups.label: Split
setups.summary: Key at 90 degrees to the side lights exactly half the face; the other half falls into darkness. Signals conflict or a divided character.

sun.notes: Interior or controlled stage; sun disabled.

setups.prompt_words: split lighting, half of the face in deep shadow

setups.label: Clamshell beauty
setups.summary: Soft key above the lens and a soft fill or reflector below, wrapping the face evenly with bright catchlights.

sun.notes: Interior or controlled stage; sun disabled.

setups.prompt_words: clamshell beauty lighting, flawless soft glow, bright catchlights

setups.label: High-key comedy / sitcom
setups.summary: Bright, flat, even light from several soft frontal sources so every actor and corner reads clearly with almost no shadow.

sun.notes: Interior or controlled stage; sun disabled.

setups.prompt_words: bright high-key lighting, even and cheerful, minimal shadows

setups.label: Low-key noir
setups.summary: A single hard key with no fill, deep pools of black and hard-edged patterns on walls (blinds, cutters).

sun.notes: Interior or controlled stage; sun disabled.

setups.prompt_words: film noir low-key lighting, hard shadows, venetian blind patterns, high contrast

setups.label: Silhouette backlight
setups.summary: Subject left unlit against a brightly lit background or a strong backlight, reading only as a shape.

sun.notes: Can use the sun or a bright window behind the subject as the background source.

setups.prompt_words: dark silhouette against a bright glowing background

setups.label: Motivated window light
setups.summary: A large soft daylight source from one side, as if from a window, with low fill and negative fill on the far side.

sun.notes: Align sun direction with the window side.

setups.prompt_words: soft natural window light from the side, motivated daylight

setups.label: Book light (soft key)
setups.summary: Key bounced into a reflector and then pushed through a diffusion frame; very large, wrapping, controllable soft light.

sun.notes: Interior or controlled stage; sun disabled.

setups.prompt_words: very soft wrapping book light, gentle falloff, prestige drama

setups.label: Practical-only night interior
setups.summary: The room is lit only by visible lamps; warm pools of light, falloff into darkness, faces lit from the nearest lamp.
setups.prompt_words: night interior lit only by warm practical lamps, pools of light, deep shadows

setups.label: Moonlight night exterior
setups.summary: Cool blue backlight and side light as moonlight, very low fill, so shapes read in rims rather than full faces.

sun.notes: Night; sun off, moon simulated by cool backlight.

setups.prompt_words: cool blue moonlight backlight, night exterior, low fill

setups.label: Neon / mixed-color night
setups.summary: Saturated colored sources (magenta, cyan, sodium orange) from opposite sides with haze; city-night mood.
setups.prompt_words: neon-lit night, magenta and cyan light, sodium vapor streetlights, wet reflections, haze

setups.label: Firelight / campfire flicker
setups.summary: Warm, low key from the fire below and in front, flickering, with a faint cool ambience behind.
setups.prompt_words: flickering warm campfire light on faces, dark night around

setups.label: Horror underlight
setups.summary: Hard light from below the face reverses natural shadows; minimal fill, darkness around.

sun.notes: Interior or controlled stage; sun disabled.

setups.prompt_words: eerie horror underlighting from below, menacing shadows

setups.label: Interrogation hard top light
setups.summary: Single bare bulb or hard spot straight overhead; eye sockets go black, background falls to darkness.

sun.notes: Interior or controlled stage; sun disabled.

setups.prompt_words: harsh overhead single bulb, interrogation room, eyes in shadow, smoky haze

setups.label: Golden-hour backlit rim
setups.summary: Low warm sun behind the subject creates a glowing rim and flare; a bounce fills the face.

sun.notes: Place the sun low behind the subject, about 5 to 10 degrees elevation.

setups.prompt_words: golden hour backlight, warm glowing rim light, sun flare, soft bounce fill
